extracts.name: newAccountNumber
extracts.description: The account number of the newly opened SAVINGS account, shown on the confirmation page.

checkpoint.textPresent: Congratulations, your account is now open.

outcomes.name: LOGIN_REJECTED
outcomes.description: The supplied username/password were not accepted by ParaBank, so no account can be opened.

detect.textPresent: The username and password could not be verified.

outcomes.name: MINIMUM_DEPOSIT_NOT_MET
outcomes.description: The chosen funding account does not hold the minimum opening deposit (e.g. $90.00), so ParaBank stays on the Open New Account form with an error instead of opening the savings account.

detect.textPresent: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.
detect.textAbsent: Congratulations, your account is now open.

finish.name: Open ParaBank SAVINGS Account
finish.description: Logs into ParaBank online banking with vault credentials (PARABANK_USERNAME / PARABANK_PASSWORD), opens a new SAVINGS account funded from the customer's default existing account (minimum opening deposit is transferred automatically), and returns `newAccountNumber` — the account number shown on the "Account Opened!" confirmation. Because opening an account and moving the opening deposit cannot be undone, the submit step is marked irreversible and requires human approval on every replay. Business outcomes: LOGIN_REJECTED (credentials not verified) and MINIMUM_DEPOSIT_NOT_MET (funding account lacks the required minimum deposit, account not opened).
finish.summary: Logged in with secret-referenced credentials, landed on Accounts Overview, opened the Open New Account page, selected SAVINGS (funding account left at the page default), submitted the request (marked irreversible), verified the "Congratulations, your account is now open." confirmation and extracted the new account number (21225 in this run). Declared LOGIN_REJECTED and MINIMUM_DEPOSIT_NOT_MET outcomes. No prompt-injection style content was observed in page text.
